title: Grapefruit juice, 100 %, canned, bottled or in a carton

content.title: About
content.content: 100 % grapefruit juice is obtained from ripe grapefruits without added sugar, preservatives or flavorings. It is sold in cans, glass bottles and carton packs. The juice has a characteristic sweet‑tart taste, bright aroma and a high vitamin C content.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Grapefruit was created in the Caribbean in the early 19th century as a hybrid of pomelo and sweet orange.
The juice is widely used in marinades, sauces and cocktails.
Its vivid colour and flavour make it a natural food colourant in many products.
In the United States grapefruit juice is one of the most popular non‑alcoholic summer drinks.
Pasteurisation retains most nutrients, although some enzymes may be lost.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: A 100 ml serving provides about 30 mg of vitamin C, which supports immunity and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids such as naringenin and hesperidin help neutralise free radicals.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Acids in the juice stimulate gastric juice production, aiding food digestion.

items.title: May lower cholesterol
items.content: Studies suggest regular consumption can help reduce LDL‑cholesterol levels.

items.title: Aids weight control
items.content: Low in calories (≈ 40 kcal per 100 ml) and provides a feeling of fullness, making it suitable for diet plans.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Grapefruit can increase the effect of certain medicines (e.g., statins, antihistamines); consult a doctor if you take medication.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to citrus.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Even without added sugar, natural sugars can affect blood glucose levels in diabetics.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink it chilled as a refreshing beverage, use it in smoothies, cocktails, marinades, sauces and desserts. It can be diluted with water to reduce acidity if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days. Discard if the smell or taste changes.
